summary: @servicetitan/anvil-css-utilities preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: Version 14.5.9 of this CSS-utilities package ships two files at the tarball root — setup.mjs and math_init.js — that are not declared in package.json's files manifest (which lists only ['dist','readme.md']). package.json wires scripts.preinstall to 'node setup.mjs', so the code runs automatically on npm install. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks the binary executable, and invokes it against the bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB @bun-cjs bundle with string-array rotation (WV8StW), a large numeric/char lookup table (n7gIxM), and a decoder routine (hc1jfK9); no readable strings or advertised functionality remain. A CSS-utilities package has no functional reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime and execute an obfuscated bundle under it, and the alternate-runtime pattern evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The presence of undeclared payload files outside the author's published manifest is consistent with a compromised-maintainer publish against the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
